name: Mummified Animal — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Mummified Animal from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Mummified Animal (CR +varies)" but are not part of the Mummified Animal entry, which is unchanged.

When adventurers venture into ancient tombs, they often discover that the mummified remains of notable individuals are not alone. Alongside these honored dead are preserved animals—creatures that held significance in the deceased’s life or symbolized their values and power. Some of these animals were not merely decorative but were imbued with necrotic energy, transformed into eternal guardians tasked with protecting the tomb and its secrets from intruders.

In undeath, these creatures’ leathery skin is pulled taut over their skeletal frames, and their eyes glow with an eerie, baleful light. Often decorated with remnants of ceremonial wrappings or painted with cursed symbols, these creatures radiate a primal malice. Unlike their living counterparts, mummified baboons neither eat nor drink, instead subsisting entirely on the necrotic energy that binds them to undeath.
